title: Habitation of houses in Leiden, 19th and 20th centuries
descriptions: This dataset concerns habitation of houses in the inner city of Leiden in the period 1890-1899 and 1930-1940. Focal point of the research was the relation between macro-economic developments in the Netherlands and demographic behaviour in Leiden. The data was collected during a seminar on Social History in 1976 and 1977, Leiden University.
